document_api_meta.title: Get Live Room View Trends
document_api_meta.env_desc: Returns viewer count trend data points for the specified live room, grouped by online, entering, and leaving viewers.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The creator access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 1. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a362dccb8030ea6f98c) to get creator access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: ^view_trend_performances
response_param.desc: Viewer count trends of the live streaming room

response_param.name: ^^stats_type
response_param.desc:
The viewer trend category.
TREND_ONLINE_VIEWER: Viewers who are watching the live streaming room.
TREND_ENTER_VIEWER: Viewers who enter the live streaming room.
TREND_LEFT_VIEWER: Viewers who left the live streaming room.

response_param.name: ^^data_points
response_param.desc: Viewer count data points for the corresponding trend category.

response_param.name: ^^^value
response_param.desc: The viewer count for the corresponding trend category at this data point.

response_param.name: ^^^timestamp
response_param.desc: The Unix timestamp of the viewer count data point, in seconds, in UTC.

error_code_list.msg: Invalid param. Please check room id.

scope_list.package_description: The application will be able to access your Live performance and engagement data such as GMV generated, items sold, engagement trends.
scope_list.auth_info: The application will be able to access your Live performance and engagement traffic.

request_path_param.name: live_room_id
request_path_param.desc: The ID of the live streaming room whose viewer trend data is requested. The live room must be associated with the authorized creator.
